name: exists_isHCParam_of_le
summary: For each w build the column counts by induction over the values of l_w in increasing order, then check the HC parameter condition.

steps.claim: For each w choose f_w and positions p by an induction on the minimum value (induction_on_min_value) of the auxiliary statement: for every set S of indices and all g, f' with g ≤ l(w, i)/2 on S there is κ' agreeing with f' above #S such that every i ∈ S has a position p < #S with l(w, i)/2 + p + 1 = g + #S + Σ_{p<h≤#S} κ'(h); the step adds the index of the smallest value and sets the count at #S + 1 to (l(w, a)/2 − g)₊ (Function.update). Apply it to S = all indices, g = e(w) − |n|/2 and f' = κ_w (hg).
steps.lean:
choose! f _ p _ using fun w ↦ (induction_on_min_value (l w) · (by aesop) fun a S _ _ ih g f
    _ ↦ (ih (l w a / 2 + 1) (Function.update f (#S + 1) (l w a / 2 - g).toNat) (by grind)).imp
    (by simp; grind [Ioc_self, sum_Ioc_succ_top]) : ∀ S g f, (∀ i ∈ S, g ≤ l .. / 2) → ∃ κ,
    (∀ k > #S, κ k = f k) ∧ ∀ i ∈ S, ∃ p < #S, l .. / 2 + p + 1 = g +
    ↑(#S + (Ioc p #S).sum κ)) univ (e w - card n / 2) (κ w) (by grind)

steps.claim: Take f; injectivity of each l_w follows from the gap (hc), and the positions p give the HC parameter formula; f agrees with κ above |n| (grind).
steps.lean: use f, fun w ↦ ⟨?_, (⟨p w ·, ?_⟩)⟩ <;> grind [Ioo_insert_right]
